tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France

    To StartLaPadite farm fromage blanc with honey and warm baguetteLanda thanks LaPadite for the milk. Whipped farm cheese, thyme honey, baguette.How to make it500g fromage blanc or quark100ml thickened cream3 tbsp honey4 thyme sprigs1 lemon, zested1 baguette2 tbsp olive oil1/2 tsp sea salt flakesWhip the fromage blanc with the cream, lemon zest and a pinch of salt until smooth and light.Warm the honey with the thyme leaves for a minute and let it sit.Slice the baguette, brush with oil and warm in a 200°C oven until crisp at the edges.Spread the cheese in a shallow bowl, pour over the thyme honey and finish with salt flakes. Serve with the bread.Wiener schnitzel fingers with lemon and capersWerner's wiener schnitzel lickin' finger. Crumbed veal fingers, lemon, brown butter capers.How to make it500g veal schnitzel, cut in fingers75g plain flour2 eggs120g fine dry breadcrumbs125ml vegetable oil60g butter2 tbsp baby capers, rinsed2 lemons, in wedges2 tbsp parsley, choppedSeason the flour, beat the eggs and set out the breadcrumbs.Dip each veal finger in flour, egg, then crumbs, pressing them on.Shallow-fry in hot oil in batches until golden, about 2 minutes a side, then drain.Brown the butter in a small pan, add the capers until they pop, then spoon over with parsley and lemon.Salted almonds and Paris butter radishesOn the bar while Goebbels holds court.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.PlatesGorlomi veal saltimbocca with sage and MarsalaBon-jorno from Aldo the Apache. Veal, prosciutto and sage, Marsala butter, soft polenta.How to make it8 thin veal escalopes8 slices of prosciutto16 sage leaves2 tbsp plain flour2 tbsp olive oil60g butter125ml dry Marsala125ml chicken stock200g instant polenta1 L milk and water, half and half50g parmesan, gratedBring the milk and water to the boil, whisk in the polenta and stir until thick, then beat in half the butter and the parmesan.Lay a slice of prosciutto and two sage leaves on each escalope and pin with a toothpick.Dust the veal with flour and fry, prosciutto side down first, in the oil and a little butter, 2 minutes a side.Lift the veal out, add the Marsala and stock to the pan and boil until syrupy, then swirl in the remaining butter.Spoon the polenta onto plates, top with the veal and pour over the pan sauce.Basement tavern choucroute garnieNever fight in a basement. Smoked pork, sausages and sauerkraut, mustard and spuds.How to make it800g smoked pork hock or kassler4 thick smoked pork sausages150g speck, cut in batons1kg sauerkraut, rinsed and squeezed1 brown onion, sliced2 Granny Smith apples, sliced8 juniper berries2 bay leaves500ml chicken stock250ml cloudy apple juice800g waxy potatoes4 tbsp Dijon mustardFry the speck in a heavy pot until the fat runs, then soften the onion in it.Stir in the sauerkraut, apple, juniper and bay, then pour in the stock and apple juice.Bury the pork in the cabbage, cover and braise at 160°C for an hour.Add the sausages and whole potatoes and braise until the potatoes are tender.Pile onto a board, slice the pork and serve with plenty of mustard.PatisserieLanda's apple strudel with whipped creamLanda says wait for the cream. Warm apple and raisin strudel, cold cream.How to make it4 Granny Smith apples, peeled and thinly sliced60g raisins80g caster sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon1 lemon, zested and juiced60g fresh breadcrumbs100g butter, melted8 sheets of filo pastry2 tbsp icing sugar300ml thickened creamToss the apples with the raisins, sugar, cinnamon, lemon zest and juice.Fry the breadcrumbs in 2 tbsp of the butter until golden.Layer the filo, brushing each sheet with butter, then scatter the crumbs along one long edge and pile the apples on top.Roll up tightly, tuck in the ends, brush with butter and bake at 190°C until deep golden.Whip the cream to soft peaks, dust the strudel with icing sugar and serve it warm with the cold cream.GlassesHellstrom's Scotch and sodaNo more German than that Scotch. Single malt, cold soda, lemon peel.How to make it240ml single malt Scotch whisky500ml soda water, well chilled1 lemon2 cups ice cubesFill 4 tumblers with ice and pour 60ml of Scotch into each.Top with cold soda, twist a strip of lemon peel over each and drop it in.A short black, Landa's wayOne espresso.
